step1_analysis.description: A pair of 50-ohm terminated source followers (adapted from emitter followers in the original bipolar design) used as an input buffer or level shifter for a high-speed logarithmic amplifier.

paper_reference.title: A DC–4-GHz True Logarithmic Amplifier: Theory and Implementation

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain of the source follower

sky130_expected.calculation: Av = gm*ro / (1 + gm*ro). For NMOS in SKY130, gm*ro is typically 10-20, yielding a gain slightly less than 1 (approx -0.5 to -1 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Source followers have a gain close to unity. Body effect and finite output resistance reduce it slightly.

bandwidth.description: Frequency where the AC gain drops by 3 dB

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB ≈ gm / (2*pi*Cgs). With gm ~ 2mS and Cgs ~ 20fF, bandwidth is > 10 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Source followers are inherently wideband. SKY130 130nm NMOS can easily exceed the 4 GHz bandwidth reported for the original bipolar process.

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the buffer

sky130_expected.calculation: P = 2 * I_bias * VDD. With I_bias = 2mA and VDD = 1.8V, P = 7.2 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The buffer consumes a small fraction of the total 750mW reported for the entire logarithmic amplifier.

rise_time.description: Transient rise time of the output signal

sky130_expected.calculation: t_rise ≈ 2.2 * R_out * C_load. R_out ≈ 1/gm ≈ 500 ohms. With parasitic load ~20fF, t_rise ≈ 22 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be very fast, well within the 100 ps reported in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the differential input buffer measuring gain, bandwidth, power, and rise time.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Input Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_n=20u L_n=0.15u I_bias=2m

* Supplies (Using negative supply to keep GND at 0V as in original netlist)
VEE VEE 0 DC -1.8

* Input Sources (50 ohm source impedance, 2V AC yields 1V at the node due to 50 ohm termination)
VIN1 in1_src 0 DC 0 AC 2 PULSE(-0.2 0.2 1n 10p 10p 1n 2n)
RS1 in1_src in1 50
VIN2 in2_src 0 DC 0 AC 0
RS2 in2_src in2 50

* DUT (Adapted to SKY130 NMOS from generic npn)
R1 0 in1 50
R2 0 in2 50
XM2 0 in1 out1 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XM1 0 in2 out2 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
I2 out1 VEE {I_bias}
I1 out2 VEE {I_bias}

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = i(VEE) * -1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1M 100G
let gain_db = vdb(out1) - vdb(in1)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1M
meas ac f3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1p 5n
* Measure rise time (approx 25% to 75% of a -0.7V to -0.5V swing)
meas tran t_rise trig v(out1) val=-0.65 rise=1 targ v(out1) val=-0.55 rise=1
.endc

quit
